options.content:
### External Secrets Operator — official dashboard (v2.15.0)
Upstream dashboard kept for reference; the day-to-day view is **External Secrets** (curated). Top row = the ESO SLIs
(error rates, workqueue depth, webhook and reconcile latency); most error gauges only show a value when it is > 0, so an
empty gauge means *no errors*. The `controller` variable filters the Controllers row. Lab: one ClusterSecretStore `vault`,
ExternalSecrets in many namespaces, refresh every hour. Removed: SecretStore / ClusterExternalSecret / PushSecret gauges
(not used here). Docs: [ESO metrics](https://external-secrets.io/latest/api/metrics/), `docs/dashboards/security.md`.

panels.title: Active alerts for this service
panels.description: Prometheus alerts of this service that are FIRING (condition true for longer than the rule's `for`) or PENDING (condition true, waiting for `for`). Same filter as the red alert annotations of this dashboard; Watchdog/InfoInhibitor are excluded. Empty = healthy. Alertmanager has no receiver in this lab, so dashboards are where alerts are seen: the rule, its threshold and source are in the rule files (helm-charts/<app>/**/prometheus.rules.yaml or the -raw release) and in docs/dashboards/. All alerts of the lab: dashboard "Alerts overview" (Observability folder).

panels.title: ClusterSecretStore error rate [15m]
panels.description: Share of ClusterSecretStore reconciles with result=error over 15 min (controller_runtime_reconcile_total). Shows only when > 0 (the query ends with '> 0'): empty = no errors. Errors mean ESO cannot validate the Vault store (sealed, auth).

panels.title: ExternalSecret error rate [15m]
panels.description: Share of ExternalSecret reconciles that failed over 15 min. Empty = no errors. Errors usually mean a missing key/property in Vault or a sealed Vault.

panels.title: Provider error rate [15m]
panels.description: Share of calls to the provider (Vault) that failed over 15 min (externalsecret_provider_api_calls_count status=error). Empty = no errors.

panels.title: Workqueue depth
panels.description: Items waiting per controller workqueue. ESO SLI: > 0 for a long time = secret delivery delayed.

panels.title: Webhook error rate [15m]
panels.description: Share of webhook requests answered with HTTP 500 over 15 min. ESO SLI 'Webhook HTTP Status Codes'. NaN/empty when there were no webhook requests in the window.

panels.title: Webhook latency [5m]
panels.description: p99 webhook latency over 5 min (ESO SLI). Empty when there were no requests.

panels.title: Reconcile latency [p99]
panels.description: p99 reconcile latency across ESO controllers over 5 min (ESO SLI).

panels.title: reconcile error rate [p99]
panels.description: Error share of reconciles over 1 min for the selected controllers. Empty = no errors.

panels.title: Provider errors [15m]
panels.description: Number of failed provider (Vault) calls per 15 min, by call. Empty = no errors.

panels.title: Not Ready ExternalSecrets  [15m]
panels.description: ExternalSecrets whose Ready condition is False. Empty table = all Ready.

panels.title: ExternalSecret sync call errors [15m]
panels.description: Failed syncs per ExternalSecret over 15 min (externalsecret_sync_calls_error, appears after the first error). Empty = no errors.

panels.title: requests by path per minute
panels.description: Webhook requests per minute by path (validate-* endpoints for each ESO kind).

panels.title: requests in flight
panels.description: Webhook requests being processed. Should be 0 almost always.

panels.title: requests by code per minute
panels.description: Webhook requests per minute by HTTP code. Any 500 is a failed validation.

panels.title: webhook latency
panels.description: Heatmap of webhook latency buckets (controller_runtime_webhook_latency_seconds).

panels.title: active workers by controller
panels.description: Workers currently reconciling per controller (controller_runtime_active_workers).

panels.title: workqueue depth
panels.description: Workqueue depth per controller over time.

panels.title: API calls by provider
panels.description: Calls to the provider (Vault) per minute by call and status.
Configured max concurrent reconciles of the selected controller.
panels.title: max concurrent: $controller
reconcile rate per minute: $controller
panels.description: Reconciles per minute by result (success, requeue_after, error) for the selected controllers. requeue_after is the normal hourly refresh.

panels.title: reconcile time latency: $controller
panels.description: Heatmap of reconcile durations for the selected controllers.

title: External Secrets (official)
description: Official External Secrets Operator dashboard, version v2.15.0 (matches the installed operator), from https://github.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/blob/v2.15.0/docs/snippets/dashboard.json. Changes: datasource pinned to the lab Prometheus, namespace → exported_namespace in the two per-object panels, intro text, descriptions, annotations; gauges for kinds the lab does not use (SecretStore, ClusterExternalSecret, PushSecret) removed.
